title: On cluster deep loci in double Bruhat cells
summary: We study deep loci for the reduced-word Berenstein-Fomin-Zelevinsky cluster atlas on type-A double Bruhat cells. As defined in CGSS24, for a seed collection on a cluster variety X, the deep locus is the complement of the union of all corresponding cluster tori. We focus on double Bruhat cells G(u,v) for G = SL(n).
